name: Treaty of Wedmore, Alfred and the Danes
summary: After Alfred the Great's victory at the Battle of Edington, the Danish leader Guthrum accepts baptism and the Treaty of Wedmore divides England: the Danes control the Danelaw (northeast) while Alfred rules Wessex and English Mercia. Alfred establishes a burghal network of fortified towns, reorganizes the fyrd, and creates a navy, transforming Wessex into the nucleus of a unified England.

_quarry.structural_significance: Creates the Danelaw as a permanent Scandinavian settlement zone; Alfred's military and administrative reforms enable his successors to conquer the Danelaw and create unified England by 927.
